subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should the grouped executable-action pin updates be approved after exact-head checks, including the Codex, token-generation, CodeQL, and container-publishing actions?
rationale: These official action updates appear compatible, but they execute in secret-bearing and security-sensitive workflows owned by the security operations area, and the repository requires explicit owner judgment for this boundary.

options.title: Approve after protected checks
options.body: Keep the grouped update and merge only after the refreshed head is green and the security workflow owners confirm the action contracts.

options.title: Split sensitive action updates
options.body: Separate Codex, app-token, CodeQL, and container-publishing bumps if owners want isolated validation and rollback boundaries.

recommendation.title: Approve after protected checks
recommendation.body: Keep the grouped update and merge only after the refreshed head is green and the security workflow owners confirm the action contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to the affected CI, release, Codex-agent, and ownership-policy surfaces.
